response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive full-stack expertise with over 15 years of experience, including 6+ years in senior roles. His background aligns closely with the required stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and secondary technologies (Kotlin/Java, PostgreSQL/MongoDB). He has delivered scalable solutions in high-traffic environments, contributed to AI-agent infrastructure, and shown leadership in technical workshops. His open-source contributions and polyglot programming approach further strengthen his candidacy.
strengths: Deep expertise in full-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js, and React
Experience with scalable architectures and high-performance systems (e.g., handling millions of requests)
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership in mentorship/workshops
concerns: Limited explicit experience with Nest.js (though Node.js expertise suggests adaptability)
No direct mention of Vitest testing framework (though Jest is referenced)
German language proficiency is basic, which may impact collaboration in a German-speaking team

key_factors.factor: Scalability and performance in high-traffic systems
